subject: GCP Marketplace access playbook + billing / escrow path
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, marketplace-ops@cloudsphere.com
Cc: 
Bcc: 
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: GCP Marketplace access playbook + billing / escrow path

Team / CloudSphere,

Thanks for the productive call this morning. I wanted to capture an internal-facing playbook draft for the GCP listing + procurement flow that CloudSphere will use to onboard Redwood as a paid listing with co-sell support. High-level asks below; attaching a working checklist and SKU mapping draft.

Top priorities (first pass):
- Confirm seller onboarding owner at CloudSphere (who completes registration, IAM perms).
- Agree billing and escrow path for the first 90 days (CloudSphere asked for escrow holdback for initial net-new customers).
- Finalize SKU mapping and pricing tiers so we can generate the GCP SKU request and comms to finance.
- Sign mutual action plan (MAP) and DocuSign for marketplace terms + billing cadence.

Immediate asks (can we have these by EOD Fri?):
1) Vanessa: assemble SKU list + proposed pricing cap by tier (I put a placeholder in sku-mapping-draft.xlsx).
2) Karthik: confirm which Redwood legal contact will accept CloudSphere escrow addenda and prepare a one-paragraph amendment.
3) Aditya & Rishi: prepare a short runbook on how we’ll route customer billing questions post-purchase (support handoff + CS contact).

Nina / Samir — can you confirm who on your side will be the Marketplace Registration owner and confirm the escrow terms CloudSphere needs (sample language would be great).

Attachments: gcp-playbook-checklist-v1.pdf; sku-mapping-draft.xlsx; mutual-action-plan-GCP-CloudSphere.docx

Thanks,

Laura Bennett
Head of GTM Partnerships
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0198
From: Nina Patel <nina.patel@cloudsphere.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: marketplace-ops@cloudsphere.com, Samir Rao <samir@cloudsphere.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 12:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GCP Marketplace access playbook + billing / escrow path

Hi Laura + team,

Thanks — that layout is super helpful. Quick answers from our side:
- Marketplace registration owner: Samir Rao (copied). He will own the GCP registration and SKU submission.
- Escrow: CloudSphere requires a 60-day revenue holdback for net-new customers on first-quarter launches; we can place funds in a platform escrow and release based on invoice milestones. I attached the standard escrow-addendum template (we'll send formally via DocuSign).
- Registration timeline: once SKU mapping is final, Samir expects to submit the SKU request in ~3 business days; GCP approval can take 5–10 business days.

Questions for Redwood:
1) Can Redwood accept the 60-day holdback in principle (we can route via DocuSign to legal)?
2) Is the pricing table finalized or a placeholder? We need committed list prices to submit.

On the MAP: please include a brief clause for co-sell attribution and lead routing to ensure CloudSphere gets a referral credit on co-sell deals.

- Nina
Product Partnerships, CloudSphere
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Nina Patel <nina.patel@cloudsphere.com>, Samir Rao <samir@cloudsphere.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GCP Marketplace access playbook + billing / escrow path

On Tue, May 11, 2027 at 12:04 PM Nina Patel <nina.patel@cloudsphere.com> wrote:
> Hi Laura + team,
> 
> Thanks — that layout is super helpful. Quick answers from our side:
> - Marketplace registration owner: Samir Rao (copied). He will own the GCP registration and SKU submission.
> - Escrow: CloudSphere requires a 60-day revenue holdback for net-new customers on first-quarter launches; we can place funds in a platform escrow and release based on invoice milestones.
> 
Thanks Nina — that's clear. Short replies to your questions:
1) Legal is ok to review the 60-day holdback; we need the CloudSphere escrow template. Karthik, can you confirm Redwood legal availability this week?
2) Pricing in sku-mapping-draft.xlsx is a first-pass but we intend to lock list prices by Thursday; Vanessa is updating the tier thresholds.

Additional note on co-sell attribution: we have an internal model for crediting partner-sourced deals (50/30/20 split by contribution). I'll attach a one-page note to the MAP with proposed attribution language.

Attachments referenced: redwood-co-sell-attribution-notes.pdf (coming in separate email)

Action items summary:
- Karthik: review escrow addendum when Nina sends it; aim to return redlines within 48 hours.
- Vanessa: finalize pricing tiers by Thu EOD.
- Samir: once you receive final SKU list, aim to submit request within 3 business days.

Thanks — will follow up with the MAP + attribution note.

—Aditya
Commercial Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Nina Patel <nina.patel@cloudsphere.com>, Samir Rao <samir@cloudsphere.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GCP Marketplace access playbook + billing / escrow path

Nina / Samir —

We received the CloudSphere escrow-addendum (DocuSign link). Quick legal summary: Redwood is willing to accept a 60-day holdback provided the following are added:
- Release triggers tied to invoice milestone verification (we request clear milestone language).
- Cap on total escrow exposure per quarter (propose $250k cap for Q1 launch).
- Audit clause limiting frequency of third-party audits to twice per year.

If CloudSphere is OK with these edits, please sign via DocuSign and Samir, proceed with SKU submission after Vanessa confirms the final pricing sheet.

I'll attach redlines in the DocuSign envelope; expect comments on clause 3 and 7.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
